referenceTitle: アンライク コーポレートサイト
direction: 生成りの紙、青緑・藍・セージの有機的な色面、曲線、編集的な見出し。機能・本文・並び順・既存の意味ある写真を保持。トップの新規オリジナルイラストだけ置換。
prompt: Create an original high-end Japanese editorial web hero illustration, landscape 3:2. A poetic cut-paper screenprint collage showing how a local maker turns a small handwritten idea into a useful digital service with AI. Huge elegant simplified hands with precise thin charcoal contour lines gently arrange a small laptop, one rough pencil product sketch, and a tiny finished shop/reservation card connected by one flowing teal ribbon. The hands and laptop must be the clear focal point. An organic undulating cyan-teal river of ideas moves from lower left through the screen to the right, with abstract sage, deep muted indigo and a very small ochre accent shape suggesting natural hills and leaves. Not a photorealistic workstation. Flat organic vector-like geometry with subtle paper grain and risograph ink texture. Warm ivory paper background occupying about 40% with generous breathable negative space. Refined adult Japanese independent design studio aesthetic, slightly playful, warm and intelligent, tactile and contemporary. Only five main elements, no busy tiny objects, no faces, no city, no classroom, no robots, no glossy 3D or neon. Distinct asymmetric rounded silhouettes. The laptop screen uses simple recognizable interface rectangles and one checkmark, no text, no words, no typography, no letters, no logo or watermark. Harmonious limited palette: ivory #f5f2e8, deep charcoal teal #263c3d, muted turquoise #64a39a, olive sage #bdc89c, indigo #526980, tiny ochre #d5aa50. Keep key objects within the central 80% for responsive cropping. This is an original illustration for AI相談 and must not duplicate any existing artist, brand characters or exact artwork.
